s.g: (US, aviation) multiengine instructor (a CFI qualified to give training in multiengine aircraft)
Of or relating to Heinrich Meibom (Meibomius; 1638–1700), German physician and scholar.
(South Africa, offensive) A female domestic servant, usually non-white.

(ecology) A group of marine or freshwater, typically benthic organisms that are intermediate in terms of size between macrofauna and microfauna, and which can pass through a 1 mm sieve, but are retained by a 45 μm sieve.
(countable, uncountable, rhetoric) A figure of speech in which something is presented as smaller or less significant than it actually appears.
(usually uncountable, cytology) Cell division of a diploid cell into four haploid cells, which develop to produce gametes.
A person of great skill or authority in a particular field.
